lines.zh: 低鸣前行，似鸵龙步履沉稳。
lines.en: Low rumbles as it walks, the Ostrich-Dragon moves steadily.

lines.zh: 沙地上的脚步声，似鸵龙在行走。
lines.en: Footsteps on the sand as the Ostrich-Dragon moves.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻摇，似鸵龙行走如风。
lines.en: Wings gently shake as the Ostrich-Dragon walks swiftly.

lines.zh: 沙地上的影子，似鸵龙缓缓移动。
lines.en: Shadow on the sand as the Ostrich-Dragon moves slowly.

lines.zh: 低低的声音，似鸵龙轻盈行走。
lines.en: Low sounds as the Ostrich-Dragon walks gracefully.

lines.zh: 沙地上的足迹，似鸵龙慢慢行进。
lines.en: Footprints on the sand as the Ostrich-Dragon advances.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙行走时，沙地微微震动。
lines.en: The ground rumbles as the Ostrich-Dragon walks.

lines.zh: 低鸣声中，似鸵龙缓缓前行。
lines.en: Low rumbles as the Ostrich-Dragon moves slowly.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙在沙地上悠闲地行走。
lines.en: The Ostrich-Dragon strolls leisurely on the sand.

lines.zh: 低沉的鸣叫中，似鸵龙行走。
lines.en: Low calls as the Ostrich-Dragon moves.
My long thin legs step in turn.
Tail held level for balance.
My neck pumps forward as I go.
My feathers shiver in the wind.

lines.zh: 站立不动，似鸵龙凝视远方。
lines.en: Standing still, the Ostrich-Dragon gazes into the distance.

lines.zh: 站立时，似鸵龙目光锐利。
lines.en: Standing, the Ostrich-Dragon has sharp eyes.

lines.zh: 静立于沙地，似鸵龙等待时机。
lines.en: Standing on the sand, the Ostrich-Dragon waits for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙静静地站立着，警惕四周。
lines.en: The Ostrich-Dragon stands quietly, vigilant around it.

lines.zh: 静止不动，似鸵龙警觉地等待。
lines.en: Standing still, the Ostrich-Dragon waits vigilantly.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙静静地站立，凝视着远方。
lines.en: The Ostrich-Dragon stands quietly, staring into the distance.

lines.zh: 站立时，似鸵龙仔细观察。
lines.en: Standing, the Ostrich-Dragon carefully observes.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙静静地站立，等待猎物。
lines.en: The Ostrich-Dragon stands quietly, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙在原地站立，保持警觉。
lines.en: The Ostrich-Dragon stands in place, maintaining vigilance.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙静静站立，准备行动。
lines.en: The Ostrich-Dragon stands quietly, ready to act.
Napping on one leg.
Stretching my neck to listen far off.
Preening the feathers on my chest.
Blinking my big eyes warily.

lines.zh: 目光转向玩家，似鸵龙警惕地观察。
lines.en: Eyes turn to the player, the Ostrich-Dragon observes cautiously.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，似鸵龙警惕地注视。
lines.en: Noticing the player, the Ostrich-Dragon watches vigilantly.

lines.zh: 看向玩家，似鸵龙警惕性提高。
lines.en: Looking at the player, the Ostrich-Dragon's alertness increases.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，似鸵龙准备行动。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on the player, the Ostrich-Dragon prepares to act.

lines.zh: 玩家出现，似鸵龙紧张地注视。
lines.en: Player appears, the Ostrich-Dragon looks tense.

lines.zh: 玩家出现，似鸵龙警觉地观察。
lines.en: Player appears, the Ostrich-Dragon observes with alertness.

lines.zh: 转向玩家，似鸵龙警觉性提高。
lines.en: Turning to the player, the Ostrich-Dragon becomes more alert.

lines.zh: 玩家进入视线，似鸵龙警惕地注视。
lines.en: Player in sight, the Ostrich-Dragon watches vigilantly.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，似鸵龙准备攻击。
lines.en: Watching the player, the Ostrich-Dragon prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，似鸵龙紧张地观察。
lines.en: Noticing the player, the Ostrich-Dragon looks nervous.

lines.zh: 歪着头，看你这根亮东西。
lines.en: Head tilted at that shiny thing of yours.
My big eyes do not blink.

lines.zh: 羽毛再多，我也飞不起来。
lines.en: All these feathers, and I still cannot fly.

lines.zh: 似鸵龙的羽毛，飞不起来。
lines.en: Struthiomimus feathers can't fly.
My long legs are limping now...
Claw hurt, I run with a limp.
Neck hurt...
Wings broken...
Foot broken...

lines.zh: 我拖着尾羽，走得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I drag my tail feathers and veer off line.
Feathers scatter on the ground.
My long legs buckle under me.
Gogogoo, some meat, please!
Born to find the tasty!
Try roasted ostrich meat!
This meat is so crispy and fragrant!
Nutrients from ostrich eggs!
Help me hatch the egg?

lines.zh: 这里的环境很适合我哦！
lines.en: Perfect environment here!
I'll protect my eggs!
More food needed!
Ostrich meat is my favorite!
I'm charging!
Move, get out of the way!
Some collision, please!
I'm blocking the path!
Don't touch me, it's dangerous!
I'm big, stay away!
I run like an ostrich, do not block me.
Stay back, I'm angry!

lines.zh: 我的胸骨撞得你退了半步。
lines.en: My breastbone knocks you back half a step.
I'm big, don't provoke me!
Even a long-legged bird wants a mate.
Mate time with my kids!

lines.zh: 我甩甩尾羽，跑过整片平原。
lines.en: I flick my tail feathers and run the whole plain.
Tail feathers swaying, I circle.
Let's build a nest together!
Please be my mate!
Share my home with you!

lines.zh: 我张开短翅，在你面前晃。
lines.en: I spread my short wings and sway in front of you.

lines.zh: 我在空地上绕着圈跑给你看。
lines.en: I run in circles on open ground for you.
We'll reproduce together!
I hatched from an egg!
Time to find some food!
The air here is fresh!

lines.zh: 我在河滩上刨出一小片空地。
lines.en: I scratch out a small patch on the riverbank.

lines.zh: 我需要找到食物填饱肚子！
lines.en: I need to find food to eat!
This land is my territory!

lines.zh: 我啄起一条虫，又看见一只。
lines.en: I peck up one bug and spot another.

lines.zh: 我需要找些食物给小家伙！
lines.en: I need to find some food for the hatchlings!
The food here tastes good!
I need to protect my home!

lines.zh: 我这双腿，跑起来收不住。
lines.en: Once these legs start, they do not stop.

lines.zh: 我低头，把眼睛对准那道影子。
lines.en: I lower my head and fix my eyes on the shadow.
It looks delicious!
I found my lunch!
I'm going to feast on my prey!
I won't let it go!
It's so small, I can eat it raw!
I need to taste it!
The meat is tender!
I'm going to enjoy my meal!

lines.zh: 草尖一晃，我的脖子就竖了。
lines.en: A blade of grass shifts and my neck snaps upright.
I stretch my neck and fix on it.
My toes are already gripping the sand.
Is it food or a threat?
I'll keep an eye on it!
I'll capture it!
I'll tame it!
I'll eat its meat!
I need it to help me!
I need its feathers!
It will be my companion!
I need to observe it!
I need to train it!
It will be my friend!
I circle to find an opening.
Long legs kick off and I charge.
Where it turns, I follow.
My beak points at its neck.
I call out first to steady myself.
One kick of these legs outsprints a horse.

lines.zh: 我连啄带踢，沙土飞起来。
lines.en: I peck and kick until the sand flies.

lines.zh: 我的喙可以刺穿你的肉！
lines.en: My beak can pierce your flesh!

lines.zh: 来吧，尝尝似鸵龙的厉害！
lines.en: Come on, taste the power of the Struthiomimus!
Don't underestimate my speed!

lines.zh: 你的骨头也挡不住我的喙！
lines.en: Your bones can't stop my beak!

lines.zh: 我提起长腿，一脚踹向你。
lines.en: I lift a long leg and kick straight at you.

lines.zh: 我的利齿可以咬碎你的肌肉！
lines.en: My sharp teeth can tear your flesh!
I am the king of the jungle!
Feed me with your flesh!
One kick from a long leg.
My beak pecks its arm.
My claws push off its body.
Three quick pecks before I back off.
Sss, I'm going to hatch the egg!
Feathers shake out; long legs find their stance.

lines.zh: 寻找我的蛋，你会后悔的！
lines.en: Find my egg, and you'll regret it!
I'm the mother of eggs, you know...

lines.zh: 我不会让任何人伤害我的蛋！
lines.en: I won't let anyone harm my egg!
Come take my egg, and you'll suffer!
My egg, the hope for survival!

lines.zh: 我是守护者，保护我的蛋！
lines.en: I'm the protector, guarding my egg!
This is my home, my egg!
My egg, the only hope!
A young one pushes up from the sand.
A shell cracks in the sandy nest.
I shake the sand off my hide.
The first thing I see is a bush.
I try a few running steps.
My feathers are still damp.
A call from my own kind, far off.
My footprints mark the edge of the nest.
My feathers catch fire at the slightest spark.
Fell down...

lines.zh: 飞不起来了...，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Can't fly — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了...，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wings hurt — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 箭插在翅羽之间，跑起来打摆。
lines.en: The arrow sits between my wing feathers and wobbles as I run.
Hit by magic...

lines.zh: 脚受伤了...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Foot hurt — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷劈在羽尖，我抖成一团。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my feather tips and I shake all over.
Dropped into void...
